answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The harbor lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the quill is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
